title: raceTelemetry.ts is production-dead (only its own unit test imports it), and its post-hoc and race functions would give wrong answers if they were ever wired in

evidence.ref: git grep -n raceTelemetry 23a64617dca167976adc4645fed0e2c69e384820 -- src test scripts dashboard
evidence.note: only the module itself and test/unit/anti-rug/raceTelemetry.test.ts:12 (measureDetectionLatency); no production import
tokenIsR0 is always false and unused; wethSaved = r1 / 100, unrelated to the position size or direction
eth_callBundle is sent through ctx.httpProvider (the chain RPC), not the Flashbots relay, together with a signed sell transaction
every error, including "method not supported", is reported as loss
V3 post-hoc uses the first V3 dex quoter of the chain and a 3000 fee default
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): Flashbots simulation is sent through the ordinary chain RPC provider
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): A positive miner payment is incorrectly reported as a race win
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): V2 recovery telemetry fabricates a WETH amount from reserve1
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): V3 post-hoc telemetry can quote a different DEX pool
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): Every V3 historical quote error is classified as a drained pool

sibling_sites_checked: Searched src, test, scripts and dashboard at the base for every export (measureDetectionLatency, flashbotsRaceVerdict, postHocReality): only the unit test uses measureDetectionLatency. The dashboard frontrun panel (DASH slice) has no data source from this module.
severity_rationale: S3: no runtime effect today. It is dead code in the money-path module tree whose telemetry would mislead the go-live review if wired as written, and whose race check would hand a signed sell to an ordinary RPC. Section-C item SC-18.
recommendation: Decide keep or delete on card OD-9; if race telemetry is wanted for the Phase 32 live gate (OD-19), rebuild it against the relay with correct post-hoc math rather than wiring this module.
